excerpt_i18n.zh: 原文作者：谭梓馨 原文链接：https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/llcXE2be4oNWItL_0ydVZw 2026年IEEE国际机器人与自动化会议（IEEE ICRA 2026）是机器人与自动化领域的顶级学术盛会，于6月1日至5日在奥地利维也纳举办。 今年，FP3、HITTER等多篇华人团队论文入围最佳论文奖提名，头部科技此前曾报道过 HITTER ，今天来看另一篇研究FP3。 FP3论文的导师之一高阳是清华大学跨学科信息科学研究院（IIIS）的助理教授，同时他也是国内具身独角兽千寻智能（Spirit AI）的联创兼首席科学家。 下面，一起来看看FP3做了哪些创新工作。 三维基座带来的改进 基于海量多任务数据预训练的基座大模型在机器人领域展现出巨大潜力，但绝大多数机器人基础策略模型仅采用二维图像作为输入观测，缺失三维几何信息，而三维几何是机器人感知、理解真实三维空间的关键。 概括来说，FP3是一个面向机器人操作的大规模三维基座策略模型。 该模型参数大小为1.3B，基于可规模化的扩散Transformer架构搭建，依托6万条含点云观测的运动轨迹完成预训练，凭借特有模型结构与多元化预训练数据，FP3可快速微调适配各类下游任务，泛化性能优异。 真机实测表明：仅需80组人工示教样本，FP3即可在包含全新未知物体的陌生场景中习得新任务，性能大幅领先现有机器人基座模型。 在自建的多项新任务数据集上验证FP3高效微调与强泛化特性，结果显示：仅使用单卡、两小时微调，相较主流基线，同场景性能平均提升60%，开放未知场景性能平均提升80%。 性能对比表现突出 FP3的在架构中设计了一个编码器-解码器扩散Transformer网络，首先对多模态输入进行编码，包括3D点云、语言和机器人本体感受状态，然后对动作进行去噪。 研究人员与业内其他机器人控制策略进行了对比，域内实验结果

The 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (IEEE ICRA 2026), a top-tier academic event in robotics and automation, will be held from June 1 to 5 in Vienna, Austria. This year, multiple papers from Chinese teams, including FP3 and HITTER, have been nominated for Best Paper Awards. Leading Tech previously reported on HITTER; today, we look at another study, FP3.  
One of FP3's advisors, Gao Yang, is an assistant professor at Tsinghua University's Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences (IIIS) and also a co-founder and chief scientist of the domestic embodied intelligence unicorn Spirit AI.  
Below, we explore the innovations of FP3.  

Improvements from a 3D Foundation  
Foundation models pre-trained on massive multi-task data show great potential in robotics, but most basic robot policy models only use 2D images as input observations, lacking 3D geometric information—crucial for robots to perceive and understand real 3D space.  
In summary, FP3 is a large-scale 3D foundation policy model for robotic manipulation.  
With 1.3B parameters, it is built on a scalable diffusion Transformer architecture, pre-trained on 60,000 motion trajectories with point cloud observations, leveraging its unique modality.

Author | Wu You    Editor | Liu Wei  

"Smart rings are still a niche market globally, with annual sales of a few million units, but I believe they will eventually catch up with smartwatches and achieve global sales of hundreds of millions." As a Distinguished Professor at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and founder of the RingConn brand, Professor Wang Guoxing shared his views on the future of smart rings on May 30 at the INNO100 Global Innovation Flagship Store in Shenzhen.  

That day marked the product launch of the RingConn Gen3. Professor Wang, dressed in a light green shirt and wearing three smart rings, attended the event to introduce the new-generation AI smart ring to tech enthusiasts and users.  

Compared to the Gen2, the Gen3 focuses on three key highlights:  

First, long-term blood pressure trend insights, enabled by clinically validated automatic monitoring every 15 minutes to reflect the user's true vascular load. It also provides comprehensive vascular health analysis and personalized improvements based on load factors such as sleep, exercise, circadian rhythm, and daily vascular stability.  

Second, the industry's first micro-awakening recognition, capable of capturing brief, unnoticed awakenings during sleep, offering a more accurate reflection of fatigue and sleep quality.  

Third, the addition of AI health vibration alerts, supporting proactive interventions in scenarios such as abnormal heart rate, prolonged sitting, excessive stress, headaches, fever, and dehydration.  

Additionally, the Gen3 features a parallel stacked architecture of seven sensors and a VCSEL infrared solution, utilizing a patented ergonomic design with a round inner and square outer shape.

excerpt_i18n.es: Faroles de pez rompen el agua, surcan la ciudad en el aire; leones de fuego pisando llamas, saltan y se elevan; un grupo de caballos de papel recortado, completamente translúcidos, galopan dentro de los muros; un poema cuelga como una cascada, ondeando en el firmamento —en la sede de Hefei de la Gala de la Fiesta de la Primavera de CCTV 2026, "Armonía Llena de Jianghuai", una serie de deslumbrantes maravillas surrealistas redefinió los límites de la imaginación entre lo real y lo virtual.
